balkans.title: Balkan
balkans.description: Slovenija, Hrvatska, Bosna i Hercegovina, Srbija, Crna Gora, Albanija, Sjeverna Makedonija i Kosovo — Beograd, Zagreb, Sarajevo, Ljubljana, Split, Tirana; dalmatinska obala, Dinaridi.

south-central-us.title: Južni centralni dio SAD-a
south-central-us.description: Teksas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi i Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson i Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa i Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Američka Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau te Wallis i Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi i Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila i ostrva Tonge.

mariana-islands.title: Guam i Sjevernomarijanska ostrva
mariana-islands.description: Guam i Sjevernomarijanska ostrva — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian i Rota.

greenland.title: Grenland
greenland.description: Grenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq i Tasiilaq; ledeni pokrov, ledeni fjord Ilulissat i fjordovi juga.

bermuda.title: Bermudi
bermuda.description: Bermudi — Hamilton, St. George’s i Kraljevsko mornaričko brodogradilište, župe ostrva i plaže sa ružičastim pijeskom.

belarus.title: Bjelorusija
belarus.description: Bjelorusija — Minsk, Gomel, Mogiljov, Vitebsk, Grodno i Brest; šuma Bjelovješka pušča i močvare Polesja.

channel-islands.title: Kanalska ostrva
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark i Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port i Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Farska ostrva
faroe-islands.description: Farska ostrva — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík i osamnaest ostrva sa njihovim selima, tunelima i morskim liticama.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard i Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg i Ny-Ålesund; ledenjaci i fjordovi Spitsbergena.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo i Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St. Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria i Tri grada.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar i ostrva Indijskog okeana
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Komori, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauricijus i Sejšeli — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis i Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Kartum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid i Nyala; ušće Plavog i Bijelog Nila i piramide Meroe.

cabo-verde.title: Zelenortska Ostrva
cabo-verde.description: Zelenortska Ostrva — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria i deset ostrva, od Santo Antãa do Brave.

sao-tome-principe.title: Sao Tome i Principe
sao-tome-principe.description: Sao Tome i Principe — São Tomé, Santo António te prašume i plaže dvaju ostrva.

saint-helena.title: Sveta Helena, Ascension i Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sveta Helena, ostrvo Ascension i Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown i Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladeš
bangladesh.description: Bangladeš — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet i Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans i delta Gangesa i Brahmaputre.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Šri Lanka i Maldivi
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Šri Lanka i Maldivi — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura i Malé; gorje, Sigiriya i atoli.

vietnam.title: Vijetnam
vietnam.description: Vijetnam — Hanoi, Ho Ši Min, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An i Can Tho; zaljev Ha Long i delta Mekonga.

philippines.title: Filipini
philippines.description: Filipini — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio i Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao i Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonezija i Istočni Timor
indonesia.description: Indonezija i Istočni Timor — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar i Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi i Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malezija, Singapur i Brunej
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malezija, Singapur i Brunej — Kuala Lumpur, Singapur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching i Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Mjanmar
myanmar.description: Mjanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine i jezero Inle; dolina Iravadija i brda Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodža i Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodža i Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap i Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang i Pakse; Mekong i Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolumbija
colombia.description: Kolumbija — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena i Bucaramanga; Ande, karipska obala i Amazonija.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida i Ciudad Bolívar; slapovi Angel, Orinoco i ostrvo Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos i Puno; Machu Picchu, jezero Titicaca i Sveta dolina.

ecuador.title: Ekvador
ecuador.description: Ekvador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta i Baños; Avenija vulkana, Amazonija i Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivija
bolivia.description: Bolivija — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre i Potosí; jezero Titicaca i Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Čile
chile.description: Čile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena i Punta Arenas; Atacama, Jezerski kraj, Patagonija i Uskršnje ostrvo.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paragvaj i Urugvaj
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paragvaj i Urugvaj — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este i Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Gvajane
guianas.description: Gvajana, Surinam i Francuska Gvajana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne i Kourou; slapovi Kaieteur i prašuma Gvajanskog štita.

falklands.title: Falklandska ostrva
falklands.description: Falklandska ostrva — Stanley, Goose Green te ostrva Istočni i Zapadni Falkland.

australia.title: Australija
australia.description: Australija — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin i Canberra; Veliki koraljni greben, Uluru i Outback.

new-zealand.title: Novi Zeland
new-zealand.description: Novi Zeland — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin i Queenstown; Južne Alpe, Fiordland i Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: Britanska Kolumbija
british-columbia.description: Britanska Kolumbija — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George i Whistler; Obalno gorje, ostrvo Vancouver i Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Kanadske prerije
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan i Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina i Banff; Stjenovite planine, prerije i Churchill na Hudsonovom zaljevu.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston i Thunder Bay; slapovi Niagare, Velika jezera i park Algonquin.

quebec.title: Québec
quebec.description: Québec — Montréal, grad Québec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke i Saguenay; rijeka Sveti Lovro, Laurentidi i poluostrvo Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantska Kanada
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Ostrvo Princa Edwarda te Newfoundland i Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton i Charlottetown; Cabot Trail i zaljev Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Sjeverna Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Sjeverozapadni teritoriji i Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City i Inuvik; Kanadski arktički arhipelag i rijeka Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong i Makao
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong i Makao — ostrvo Hong Kong, Kowloon, Novi teritoriji, Lantau te poluostrvo Makao, Taipa i Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antarktika
antarctica.description: Antarktika — stanica McMurdo, baza Scott i Villa Las Estrellas; Antarktičko poluostrvo, Južna Šetlandska ostrva, Rossova ledena ploča i planina Erebus. Karta se završava na 85° južne širine i ne doseže Južni pol.
